scope: Targeted public-report corroboration, not a census, forensic dataset comparison or complete monitoring-account archive.
method: Search Spanish institution and incident terms with 2025/2026 and September/October qualifiers; follow original news and authority responses.
Separate occurrence, public claim, publication, enforcement and resale dates; retain unknowns.
Do not collect leaked samples or infer unique people from rows, files, images or bytes.
Syndicated copies and monitors repeating one seller post share an evidence chain.
